## Summary

Describe the problem and the change. Link the relevant issue or design
discussion when one exists.

## Validation

List the exact commands and platforms used to test this change.

## Authorship

Describe any AI-agent or generative-tool use, including the files and parts of
the change it affected. Write `None` if no such tool authored the change.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] If I am not a maintainer, this pull request comes from a branch in my
      fork, not from an upstream repository branch.
- [ ] I understand that a contributor pull request requires one approving
      review from a Flecha maintainer before merge.
- [ ] I have read and followed `CONTRIBUTING.md`, including its human-authorship
      and AI-assisted contribution policy.
- [ ] All Flecha standard-library, `.fl`, self-hosted, and other non-core
      feature code in this pull request is human-authored.
- [ ] I understand and take responsibility for every submitted line.
- [ ] I added or updated tests and documentation where the behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not commit build outputs, credentials, or unrelated changes.
